# Solana Swap

> Solana Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping SOL, USDC, USDT and other SPL tokens on Solana. Users connect a wallet such as Phantom or Solflare, review a DEX-routed quote and sign each transaction themselves. The page explains fees in SOL, token accounts and slippage.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Solana Swap covers SOL, USDC, USDT and other SPL tokens on Solana.
- Transaction fees on Solana are paid in SOL, including for token swaps.
- SPL tokens need no separate approval, but a new token may need a token account with a small refundable rent deposit.
- Quotes come from on-chain DEX routing and show price impact and a slippage tolerance.
- The interface is non-custodial: it never holds funds or keys and the user signs every transaction.

## Pages

- Solana Swap & learn: https://swap-solana.github.io/
- Legal: https://swap-solana.github.io/legal.html
